page.overview:
Who is Graveyard?

"Graveyard" was a , son of the Predator King, and the older brother of the Predator Prince.

The Yautja known only as "Graveyard" was the eldest and strongest son of the Predator King, earning him his father's favor and causing his younger brother, the Predator Prince, to become jealous and challenge Graveyard to a blood hunt. In the ensuing battle, where each brother led a hunting party to war against each other, Graveyard was lent his father's Vibranium spear and ultimately prevailed with the weapon. But rather than grant the Prince an honorable death, Graveyard chose to humiliate his brother by tying him to a totem and abandoning him. The smarter and more technologically-advanced Predator Prince escaped and sought revenge against his family, hoping to restore his honor by acquiring the same metal that the spear was forged from by invading the Earth country Wakanda. The Prince's heist was successful, but he was killed while attempting to flee the planet, shortly after he had broadcasted a message to the Predator King and Graveyard that he was coming for them with a Vibranium arsenal that would rival their own. The Prince's destroyed ship and his stolen Vibranium returned to the Clan, who used the Vibranium to strengthen their arsenal and turned their attention back to Earth.

The Predator King's goal of invading Earth was set into motion through Kraven the Hunter, who earned the clan's respect after the human had killed their most dishonorable member, Skinner. Graveyard trained Kraven in the Yaujta ways during his time with the Predators, and Kraven returned the favor by providing him, his father, and his clan with information on Earth's superhero defenders, including how to best defeat and kill them. After eliminating two superhero groups that would interfere with their plan - the Guardians of the Galaxy and the Fantastic Four - the Yautja began their attack with two strike forces. While Kraven led a hunting group to attack the Avengers, Graveyard led another to infiltrate the Xavier Institute, home of the X-Men.

Graveyard's hunting party immediately killed Magneto with a giant Vibranium magnet that crushes him, eliminating one of the most dangerous threats to the Predators. Graveyard then led his group into the mansion's Danger Room, where the X-Men mistook the Predators for simulations before Graveyard bashed Cyclops in the jaw with his mace. The Predators then laid waste to the Xavier Institute and set it ablaze, killing and skinning any mutant they found. The mutant Wolverine soon approached the burning mansion on his motorcycle, horrified to see his home burning and his friends and mentor dead. After disposing of the burning body of Charles Xavier, Graveyard engaged Wolverine in combat until a blast from his mace melted the flesh from Wolverine's face and exposed his adamantium skull. Realizing this made Wolverine a valuable trophy, Graveyard attempted to finish Wolverine off until a surviving Nightcrawler teleported him away.
